PR Commit message:

```
The Ollama and Ollama Cloud adapters only handled ChatResponseFormat::JsonMode
(format: "json"); a JsonSpec was silently ignored, so structured output never
reached the model. Ollama takes the JSON Schema itself as `format`, so send the
spec's schema for JsonSpec. Both adapters share one helper for the mapping.

Co-authored-by: Claude Sonnet 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
```
